| first-prediction: First recorded prediction from live prices and memory, resolved by code | verified | Prices are stored every 5 minutes and survive a process restart; No prediction can be recorded when the asset's latest price is older than 15 minutes; A prediction cannot be recorded without probability, condition, horizon and hypothesis link; A recorded prediction cannot be updated or deleted through the agent's tools; At its horizon, code resolves the prediction from stored prices and computes its Brier score; Resolution appends one evidence row to the linked hypothesis and updates its computed confidence; /statut shows open and resolved predictions in French; Tests make no network or paid inference calls | .likma/checks/fcd819cffb38439089e836b6e3622927.json |
